listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses the NTP daemon will listen on for incoming NTP requests.

allowed_networks.description: List of allowed client networks/hosts with optional netmask. Each entry must contain 'address' (IPv4/IPv6) and 'mask' (CIDR prefix length).

address.description: Base IP address of the allowed network (e.g., '192.168.1.0').

mask.description: Netmask as CIDR prefix length (e.g., 24 for /24). Use 32 for a single host.

servers.description: List of upstream NTP servers to synchronize with. Each server entry includes hostname and optional iburst flag.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the upstream NTP server (e.g., 'pool.ntp.org').

iburst.description: When true, use 'iburst' mode (fast initial sync with burst of packets).

fallback_to_local_clock.description: Enable fallback to local clock if all external servers are unreachable. Requires driftfile and optionally allows local-clock synchronization.

allow_local_clock.description: Allow this host to act as an NTP server even when using local clock as fallback (i.e., unsynchronized). Should only be used in isolated networks.

step_first.description: Step clock immediately on large initial offset instead of slewing. Only effective if enabled; threshold controls the offset limit.

step_first_threshold.description: Maximum offset (in seconds) to trigger immediate clock stepping. Only used if `step_first` is enabled.
